natural_input.description: Topology diagram with only Router 0, Router 1, Router 2, Router 3, Router 4. A unidirectional ring has exactly Router 0 -> Router 1 -> Router 2 -> Router 3 -> Router 4 -> Router 0. No reverse or diagonal links, no shared bus and no implicit coherence guarantee.
